xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5476: docs: conversation search and the command palette

plan.title: docs: conversation search and the command palette
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: No user page explains the Ctrl+K command palette or conversation search. The facts sit in code, the Settings card, CLI help and changelog entries v0.65.0 (#4375), v0.71.0 and v0.89.0 (#5447). Users cannot learn the scopes, the title-first ranking, that semantic search needs an OpenAI key (without one the palette finds titles only), or that pan conv search uses a separate catalog.
narratives.Proposal: Add a '## Command palette' section to features/keyboard-shortcuts.mdx and a '## Search your conversations' section with four subsections (Find a conversation, Set up semantic search, When search is not working, Search from the command line) to features/conversations.mdx, plus cross-links in the See also list and cli/overview.mdx. Every claim comes from the PRD fact sheet (F-1 to F-40), re-verified against code and pan conv --help. Finish with the pinned Mintlify checks and a dash check.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new docs page and no docs.json change.
- No creation of cli/conversation-commands.mdx (owned by #5478).
- No line-by-line audit or em dash cleanup of existing text in the touched pages (owned by #5502); existing See also bullets stay as they are.
- No code, UI string or behavior change, even for stale strings such as the desktop-menu comment in CommandPalette.tsx or 'port 3010' in the palette command catalog.
- No screenshots; images/ has none of the palette or the Conversation Search card.
- No claim that keyword transcript search works without an OpenAI key.
- No changelog.d entry.

autoDecisions.summary: Add sections to the two named pages instead of creating a new page; no docs.json change
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body names exactly these two files ('Add sections to features/conversations.mdx or features/keyboard-shortcuts.mdx'). The palette is a keyboard feature and conversation search is a conversation feature, so each part goes where a reader of that page looks.

autoDecisions.summary: Settings path is Settings → Conversations → Conversation Search, with the key in Settings → Providers → OpenAI
autoDecisions.rationale: settingsPageConstants.ts and ConversationSearchSection.tsx show the card under the Conversations section; the issue's 'Settings → Conversation Search' is shorthand. Code wins.

autoDecisions.summary: State that without an OpenAI key the palette finds conversations by title only
autoDecisions.rationale: conversation-search-service.ts returns no chunk hits at all, BM25 included, when the provider is unavailable; title search runs separately.

autoDecisions.summary: Document pan conv embed/search --semantic as a separate catalog that does not feed the palette
autoDecisions.rationale: The palette reads ~/.overdeck/conversations/embeddings.db (conversationSearch config); pan conv reads discovered sessions in overdeck.db with conversations.embedding* config. Conflating them would send users to the wrong command.

autoDecisions.summary: Link cli/conversation-commands.mdx only if it exists when the work runs
autoDecisions.rationale: #5478 creates that page in parallel; a link to a missing page fails mint broken-links.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep edits additive and leave existing em dashes in untouched lines
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires dash-free added lines and frontmatter; #5502 audits the whole pages, and rewriting 1,200 lines here would conflict with it.
